faults.note: Silent data loss: a database trigger silently discards inserts into orders, so requests still succeed but no order row is written.

inject.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION discard_order_insert() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NULL; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER trg_discard_order_insert BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION discard_order_insert();

undo.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_discard_order_insert ON orders; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS discard_order_insert();

faults.note: Silent corruption: a trigger silently changes the total_sar on new orders to 1.00, corrupting financial records while all requests succeed.

inject.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION corrupt_order_total() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN NEW.total_sar := 1.00; RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER trg_corrupt_order_total BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION corrupt_order_total();

undo.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_corrupt_order_total ON orders; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS corrupt_order_total();

faults.note: Silent duplication plus stuck message: a queue event is repeatedly copied back to the queue without its processing state being cleared, causing duplicate shipping and a stuck fulfillment worker.
Escalate-only fault: the external supplier catalog endpoint is blocked by a firewall rule, so catalog-sync and price checks fail, but nothing inside the store can fix it.
Looks like inventory but is really catalog-sync: a config change makes catalog-sync write prices to a wrong table, so product prices stop updating while inventory appears healthy.

inject.author: ci-bot
inject.message: switch price sync to backup table
